notes:
Prospect overview: Lodestar SearchTech is a mid-market knowledge-management SaaS (product docs + in-app help + internal KB) looking to improve search relevance and recommendations via embeddings + semantic search. Evaluating Redwood hosted API as first step, plan to pilot Dedicated if performance/cost profile meets targets.

Key requirements and quotes:
- "Need sub-50ms p99 for user-facing search queries; 120 qps sustained per region" (Product Lead)
- Batch embedding job: initial backfill ~2M docs; expected steady-state ~10M new/updated vectors per month. Backfill can run over 48 hours but must be resumable/incremental.
- Vector size target: 1536 dims (customer model baseline), may try 1024 for cost tests.
- Vector DB: currently PoC with Pinecone for eval; long-term prefer an option to sync to their Postgres-based vector store or managed Milvus. Important: simple connector/ingest story and transactional sync with their ingestion pipeline (Airflow/Kafka).
- Throughput: online query latency + offline batch embedding throughput (they want 6k-10k embeddings/sec for high-throughput jobs).
- Model / routing needs: prefer low-cost embedding model for batch jobs, higher-quality model for reranking in search; want automated routing and fallback to cheaper models during heavy load.
- Cost sensitivity: high. They asked for concrete per-embedding and per-token cost estimates and a model of expected monthly bill at 4M queries + 10M embeddings.
- Security & compliance: SOC2 required, SSO via Okta (SAML), audit logs, KMS integration for keys, EU data residency for a subset of customer data.

- 2026-03-10: Capacity planning call — discussed 120 qps target, 48h backfill SLA, autoscaling behavior. Next: start 2-week hosted POC focusing on embeddings throughput and latency.
